imports.name: Google Takeout
imports.takes: Google takes minutes, or hours with photos

guide.title: Choose what Google sends
guide.words: On Google Takeout, press Deselect all, then tick Mail, Calendar, Contacts, Google Photos and My Activity. Under My Activity, press Multiple formats and choose JSON.

guide.title: Make the export
guide.words: Press Next step. Keep Send download link via email, Export once and .zip, choose 10 GB files, and press Create export.

guide.title: Wait for the email
guide.words: When Google emails you, download every file.

drop.line: Lifestream reads a copy; your file stays where it is.

imports.line: Google takes minutes, or hours with photos

imports.name: iPhone backup
imports.takes: Finder takes an hour or more

guide.title: Plug in your iPhone
guide.words: Plug your iPhone into this Mac. In Finder, choose it in the sidebar.

guide.title: Choose an encrypted backup
guide.words: Under Backups, choose Back up all of the data on your iPhone to this Mac and tick Encrypt local backup. Set a password: calls are in the backup only when it's encrypted.

guide.title: Back up
guide.words: Press Back Up Now. It takes an hour or more; the phone can stay in use.

drop.line: Lifestream reads a copy; your file stays where it is.

imports.line: Finder takes an hour or more

guide.title: Ask ChatGPT
guide.words: In ChatGPT, open Settings › Data controls and press Export data.

guide.title: Wait for the email
guide.words: Download the zip from ChatGPT’s email within 24 hours.

drop.line: Lifestream reads a copy; your file stays where it is.

guide.title: Ask Claude
